title: Fruit Veggie Rainbow
hook: Color is one clue; plant part is another.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: vivid 3D fruit-and-vegetable storybook, rainbow produce palette, simple baskets, clean isolated foods

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child classifying edible plant parts
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: plant part plus visual clue; nutrition-neutral
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: plant-part cue -> recall beat -> target -> card-sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a bright marimba color-pluck and one ukulele basket-step after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a bright marimba color-pluck and one ukulele basket-step after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Fruit Veggie Rainbow a plant-part and color study: root, leaf, stem, flower-derived fruit, tuber and cactus fruit are separated, while color is observed without treating it as nutrition ranking.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sorts produce by the plant part we eat, then notices color as a second clue.
imageMotifs: xoconostle-like cactus fruit contrast through xigua mapping
